item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: As you heard in our morning prayer today, our parish priest, Fr. Gerard, from Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal parish has passed away. You are invited to come to the chapel today to say a special prayer for Fr. Gerard and his family as we remember him and entrust him to our loving God. Please let your teacher know that you would like to come down, and Mr. Vonesch will gladly receive you. Thank you
